meta.rules: 2023+ SAF–RSF items REPORTED; UN/OCHA cites required. Outcome uses attributed control wording ('RSF took control of X by DATE (per SOURCE, report date)') only where a registered UN or OCHA text states control outright; otherwise placeholder 'Reported fighting; see cited report'. Never stated as our own claim. No fatality figures (IM ruling 2026-10-25)

battles.internal_note: Claim-level notes, not the outcome: UN News, 28 Oct 2025 (UNNEWS_20251028_ELFASHER) says the RSF "have reportedly taken control" of El Fasher. OHCHR, 27 Oct 2025 (OHCHR_20251027_ELFASHER) says the RSF seized control of "large parts" of the city and that the RSF announced its takeover of the army's 6th Infantry Division on 26 Oct 2025 (date_to).
